# Cetana Labs (LAB-000)

> Cetana Labs is the master **engineering control plane** for a portfolio of Agni initiatives — mini-apps, research spikes, data pipelines, benchmark verifications. It is NOT a monorepo: mini-app source lives in external repos. Purpose: zero-overhead executive visibility (leads report a ≤35-line `STATUS.md`; leadership gets an auto portfolio registry + daily broadcast). Stack: zero-dependency Python governance scripts, a relational `data/` layer, a PocketBase backend (Railway) and a SvelteKit "Sleek UI" (Vercel). Delivery follows a converged AIDLC lifecycle with a human-held merge gate.

This file is a convenience **entry map** for agents and humans reading the repo cold — a curated index of the canonical docs. It is a mirror, not a source of truth: when it disagrees with the linked doc, the doc wins.

## Start here
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): the authoritative agent contract — operating principles, commit conventions, branch model, the skill-hook convention, two-phase governance.
- [README.md](README.md): the front door — repo layout, quick start, cheatsheet, and the generated project master registry.
- [Docs hub](docs/README.md): the full documentation index with the breadcrumb + footer-nav standard.

- [Release guide](docs/guides/release-guide.md): promote-to-staging, Railway + Vercel deploy, live-bundle verification.
- [Sprint lifecycle](docs/guides/sprint-lifecycle.md): the brainstorm → implement → verify → done state machine.
- [Project owner guide](docs/guides/project-owner-guide.md): how a lead onboards and reports a project.
- [RGS guide](docs/guides/rgs-guide.md): the requirement-gathering chat skill.
- [User guide](docs/guides/user-guide.md): using the Sleek UI web app.
